confirm_vs_refute.H1: CONFIRMS a genuine wide (>=7-bit) srcA_reg field if X=67 reads 0.0 (r67, unwritten); CONFIRMS aliasing to EXP-0099's own low-6-bit pattern if X=67 reads 30.0 (r3's seeded value); REFUTES BOTH if neither.
confirm_vs_refute.H2: Per candidate bit: CONFIRMS a genuine bank-select mechanism if the reg=67 case changes from 0.0 to something else while reg=3 stays at 30.0; REFUTES the candidate as a bank selector (inert either way) if both stay at their baselines; identifies the candidate as LOAD-BEARING-BUT-NOT-A-BANK-SELECTOR if the reg=3 case ALSO changes from 30.0 (typically to 0.0, the established silent-zero pattern).

oracle_source: casematrix.py build_cases() -- pure Python, computed independently of any GPU run, using isadb.imm_encode/imm_decode for the minifloat immediate domain (H.imm_value(), a fixed point of that codec) and EXP-0090/EXP-0099's own HW-validated falu2/falu2i/device_store field conventions
abandoned_mechanism_disclosure: This experiment's pilot phase (PROGRESS.md Milestone 2) attempted a second, structurally different register-addressing method using `iminmax` (plain 8-bit register fields, per db.json). Two independent attempts (anchor-splice on a real compiled instance; hand-built from scratch) both produced results this experiment could not interpret safely (splicing a register field had NO effect on output even for in-range low registers; a hand-built program failed to read back a mov_imm-seeded low register at all). NEITHER attempt is part of the gated capture -- disclosed here and in PROGRESS.md/RESULTS.md as a first-class negative finding, not silently dropped.
clean_room: OWN-SHADER + HW-PROBE + PUBLIC. Every byte executed is either our own hand-assembled instruction sequence (tools/agx-isa isadb.assemble()) or the compiled form of our own carrier MSL (tools/shdump). EXP-0092's get_sr/device_store index_reg round-trip finding is cited as PUBLIC-to-this-experiment (prior committed repository evidence, not re-derived here) wherever referenced. No Apple binary introspected.
